subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the cartoon calf character from <Picture 1>, a small anthropomorphic bull with full-body orange-brown fur, a grey muzzle, small rounded ears, visible hands with fingers, and a compact chubby body shape, shown in three-view reference (front/side/back).
<Subject 2> is the young Asian man from <Picture 2>, with short black hair, round face, wearing a light mint-green short-sleeved button-up shirt printed with small colorful cartoon patterns and a "Butterbear" bear logo on the left chest pocket, grey straight-leg trousers, and white sneakers.
<Subject 3> is the classroom environment from <Picture 3>, featuring a worn green chalkboard with red Chinese characters "团结紧张 严肃活泼" along the top border and white characters "好好学习 天天向上" written in the center, weathered pale-green walls with a two-tone green paint scheme below, tall windows with multiple panes letting in natural daylight, old wooden student desks, and a scarred wooden arm-wrestling table marked with "302".
<Picture 3> is the composition and pose reference for the arm-wrestling confrontation, establishing the seating arrangement, grip position, facial expressions, and camera angle of both subjects locked in the match.

summary:
[reference generation + keyframe completion] The target video is a 15-second tense comedic arm-wrestling scene between <Subject 1> the cartoon calf and <Subject 2> the young man across the desk in <Subject 3> the vintage Chinese classroom. The escalating tension through alternating close-ups culminates in a surprise table explosion. Uses <Picture 3> as the core pose and framing anchor.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the orange-brown fur, grey muzzle, rounded ears, hand anatomy, and chubby body proportions are retained exactly as shown in the three-view reference.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the mint-green patterned Butterbear shirt with chest-pocket bear logo, grey trousers, white sneakers, and facial features are retained exactly.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]; shattered in [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the chalkboard text ("团结紧张 严肃活泼" / "好好学习 天天向上"), two-tone green walls, window lighting, old wooden desks, and table-302 marking are all retained up to the moment of the explosion. The unexpected table shattering is a plot event, not a loss of reference fidelity.
<Picture 3> ([Shot 1] keyframe): fully_preserved - the arm-wrestling grip pose, seated positions, facial tension expression, and medium two-shot composition serve as the opening frame anchor.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a tense cinematic comedy style with dramatic close-up cutting, shallow depth of field on faces, and naturalistic classroom lighting from tall windows creating soft directional shadows. The color palette is warm and slightly desaturated, emphasizing the worn texture of the classroom. The score accelerates from a slow heartbeat pulse to explosive chaos.

[Shot 1] The video opens on a medium two-shot framed from <Picture 3>, showing <Subject 1> the orange-furred cartoon calf with grey muzzle and visible hands on the left side of the scarred wooden desk marked "302", locked in an arm-wrestling grip with <Subject 2> the young man in the mint-green Butterbear shirt on the right side. Both elbows planted firmly on the desk, forearms trembling with maximal effort. Behind them, <Subject 3> the chalkboard displays "好好学习 天天向上" in white chalk beneath "团结紧张 严肃活泼" in red. The calf's face contorts in fierce determination, brows furrowed, sweat on its orange forehead. The man's jaw is clenched, veins at his temple. The camera holds steady for a beat, freezing the moment of maximum pre-explosion tension.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the shot cuts to an extreme close-up of <Subject 2> (S1) the man's face — eyes, nose, and tensed mouth filling the frame. Sweat beads roll down his temple. His eyes narrow into competitive slits and he grinds out through clenched teeth in a taunting, breathless voice, [Chinese] 勇敢牛牛。 His lips curl into a strained smirk. The chalkboard dissolves into creamy bokeh behind him, micro-expression razor-sharp.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the shot whips to a matching extreme close-up of <Subject 1> (S2) the calf's face, frame filled with wide panicked eyes, flaring nostrils on the grey muzzle, trembling mouth. Bravado collapses into distress; ears flatten back; sweat drips off its chin. With a cracking pitiful wail climbing from low to desperate shriek, <Subject 1> (S2) cries out, [Chinese] 啊妈妈~。 The vowels stretch and warble with cartoonish suffering; its visible fingers begin to slip against the man's palm.

[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, the shot cuts back to a wide two-shot echoing <Picture 3>'s composition, now showing both contestants straining at absolute peak force — the calf's whole body shakes, the man's free hand white-knuckles the desk edge. A high-pitched wooden CREAK rises; fine splinters and dust start popping off the "302" table's surface; hairline cracks race across the worn wood. Camera pushes in a few inches, building unbearable suspense — the table is about to give.

[Shot 5] At 00:11.500, the table EXPLODES. With a thunderous wooden CRACK, the "302" desk bursts apart in a blast of splintered boards and chalk-dust clouds. <Subject 1> (S2) and <Subject 2> (S1) lose their支撑 in the same instant — both lurch forward off their seats, arms still locked together in the now-handshake grip, bodies tipping toward each other through the debris. The camera freezes on the frame of peak mid-air collapse, shock on both faces, surrounded by slowly drifting wood shards and a suspended chalk-dust haze. The clip ends on this absurd hanging beat, tension snapping into pure comedy without resolving who won.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet slightly-echoey classroom room tone throughout the first three shots, with close-miked physical sounds: creaking desk strain, wet sweat dripping on wood, heavy labored breathing escalating in rhythm, leathery fur knuckles shifting grip. From Shot 4, a rising high-pitched wooden groan and popping splinter cracks. At Shot 5, a sudden loud wooden explosion — a deep CRACK layered with shattering planks, a puff of chalk-dust whoosh, and both bodies' surprised gasps. All sounds intimate and close, heightening the claustrophobic-to-chaotic swing.

non_diegetic_music:
A driving minimalist percussion tension score under the whole scene: a slow heartbeat bass-drum pulse (90 BPM) accelerating through Shots 1–4 (rising to ~120 BPM), with a sustained low drone swelling beneath. At Shot 5 the beat detonates into a single massive impact hit synchronized to the table explosion, then drops abruptly to a silent beat before a comedic record-scratch sting lands on the frozen collapse frame. No melody — pure rhythmic build to explosive punchline.
